dedupe_keys.name: catalonian school sustainability and food waste management survey 2018

description: This CSV contains questionnaire responses from 548 public and private primary and secondary school headteachers in Catalonia in 2018. Didier Grimaldi and collaborators collected information on canteen management, school sustainability practices, perceived food-waste generation and interest in waste-reduction measures. School attributes include size and infrastructure. Mendeley distributes the file free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is the responding Catalonian schools in a single survey year, not repeated measurements of meal quantities or discarded food. Self-reported practices and perceptions are limitations for estimating actual material flows or the effect of a proposed intervention. Modellers could parameterise school participation and adoption assumptions in food-waste prevention simulations, with additional measured quantities where needed. data-fao-food-loss-and-waste-database is a related food-loss resource at different scales. The article documents how responses were organised, but no response rows or school identities were downloaded. Questionnaire coding and representativeness were not independently checked.
name: Catalonian school sustainability and food-waste management survey, 2018
